question: In the morning session of the trivia marathon Rosa played 4 rounds and scored exactly 142 points in every round. During the afternoon the judges awarded her 55 extra points for winning a tie-breaker, and before the dinner break she picked up another 66 points. Her teammate Dev ended the evening holding double the number of points Rosa had at that moment. A late correction by the scorers then added 75 points to Dev's tally. How many points did Dev finish the marathon with?

A food bank packed 211 crates on each of 7 collection days. Lorries carried 1185 of those crates away to village halls during the same week. Every crate still in the warehouse was then broken down into 6 smaller cartons for doorstep delivery. A supermarket sent over 54 ready-made cartons to add to the pile. The warehouse has 23 loading bays along its north wall. How many cartons is the food bank holding now?

Priya began the month with 238 pounds saved up. Tutoring earned her another 37 pounds, and then a long repair bill took 272 pounds out of the same savings. A refund of 28 pounds arrived a week later. Her uncle Marcus, who compared her total with his own, promised to top her up until she held 5 times the amount she had at that point, and he kept his word. Her birthday brought 39 pounds in cards, and she finally put the whole lot into a scheme that returns 3 times whatever is placed in it. Her bicycle had cost 410 pounds when it was new. How many pounds did Priya end up with?

A stationery depot opened the morning with 171 cartons of sticker sheets and sent 123 of them out on the early van. Each carton left on the floor contains 9 packs. At midday a supplier dropped off 11 loose packs to join them. Every single pack, old or new, holds 8 sheets, and each sheet carries 9 stickers. In the evening a customer returned 32 individual stickers still on their backing, and the owner, who has run the depot for a dozen years, wanted the full count. How many stickers does the depot hold in total?

A small cinema ran 5 screenings on Saturday and sold 187 tickets at each one. Every ticket brought in 4 dollars at the door. The projectionist and the two ushers were paid a combined 1377 dollars for the day out of those takings. Film hire and electricity came to another 1686 dollars from the same money. The till prints its figures in cents, though the manager copies them into her book as dollars. How many dollars were left from Saturday's takings?

Leah baked 102 muffins on each of 7 mornings for the school fair. Her friend Tom, who baked rather fewer than she did, handed over 25 muffins of his own for the same table. A neighbour added 69 more to the pile. Customers bought 144 muffins on the opening day, and a late delivery of 54 arrived that evening. On the second day another 261 muffins were sold from the table. The recipe card gives its oven time in minutes rather than hours, and the fair itself ran for 12 hours. How many muffins are left on Leah's table?

Mr. Okafor counted 193 sticker sheets in the supply cupboard and threw out 4 that were water-damaged. He split the rest equally between 3 classes, so each class received the same number of sheets. Ms. Bell's class, which received exactly as many as the others, then gave 20 of its sheets to the nursery. Every sheet still with Ms. Bell's class is printed with 6 rows, and each row holds 5 stickers. The same cupboard also contains 84 spare rulers. How many stickers does Ms. Bell's class have?

A scout troop collected 53 tins of pencils for a school appeal. They handed 30 of those tins to a shelter across town. Over the following week the number of tins the troop was holding doubled. Every tin in their store contains 9 pencils. A teacher then dropped off 15 loose pencils to go with them. The troop's log records meeting times in minutes instead of hours. How many pencils does the troop have altogether?

A community centre stored 115 boxes of leaflets, and every box held 6 bundles. Each bundle was made up of 6 leaflets. A volunteer added 39 loose leaflets that had been left on the counter. Over the campaign 2664 leaflets were pushed through letterboxes. Two later deliveries brought 14 and then 22 more leaflets back to the centre. The opening hours on the noticeboard are written in minutes rather than hours. How many leaflets does the centre have now?

A charity drive began the day with 139 tins of biscuits on the trestle table. A local bakery added 20 tins, a school class brought 26, and a delivery van dropped off another 50. Every one of the tins on that table holds 7 biscuits. At the close of the drive a sponsor matched the entire collection, so the number of biscuits was doubled. The organisers time their collection rounds in minutes rather than hours. How many biscuits did the drive finish with?

Dario's market stall took 130 dollars on each of 7 trading days. He paid 577 dollars to his wholesaler out of that money. A supplier then refunded him 56 dollars for a crate that never arrived. The stall's rent for the fortnight came to 275 dollars, which he also paid from the same pot. He put everything that was left into a co-operative scheme that returns 4 dollars for each dollar invested, and it paid out in full. His stall is number 18 in the row. How many dollars did Dario end up with?

A swimming club had 57 members registered at the start of April. A poster campaign brought in 55 new members during that month. Then 6 members moved away, and 19 more signed up after the open day. When the club merged with a neighbouring team, its membership doubled overnight. The club's timetable lists every session in minutes instead of hours. How many members does the swimming club have now?

Helen and Raj found 202 conkers under the big tree and split them equally between the 2 of them. Helen gave 71 of her own conkers to her cousins that afternoon. On the way home she lost another 11 through a hole in her coat pocket. Her grandmother then handed her 34 conkers saved from the previous autumn. The tree they collected under is 47 years old, and Helen measures the string she threads them on in centimetres rather than metres. How many conkers does Helen have now?

A bottling plant filled 162 crates during each of its 9 morning shifts. At lunchtime a partner factory sent over 43 extra crates. Through the afternoon two lorries took away 574 crates and then 614 crates. In the evening 68 crates came back undelivered and were put on the same stack. Every crate left on that stack was repacked into 3 shallow trays for the shop run. The plant's yard can hold 250 pallets. How many trays did the repacking produce?

A parcel depot began Tuesday with 124 parcels on the sorting bench. A late van brought in 69 more. Then 5 parcels were pulled out as damaged, and 44 went off on the first delivery round. Every parcel still on the bench contains 3 separately wrapped items. The drivers cover 87 kilometres on a typical round and log their journeys in minutes rather than hours. How many wrapped items are on the bench?

Sofia counted 197 eggs in the farm's cold room on Friday morning. A restaurant order took 182 of them straight away. She then found 9 eggs cracked in their trays and threw those out. Her colleague Anton, who keeps far fewer hens than Sofia does, borrowed 2 for the staff kitchen. On Saturday the hens gave 74 more eggs, and a neighbouring farm sent 13 across as a thank-you. Anton has worked on this farm for a dozen seasons. How many eggs are in the cold room now?

Grace filled 96 trays for the school garden, and every tray held 4 seedlings. She and her friend Owen planted the whole lot across 4 beds, sharing them out equally, though Owen looked after fewer beds than Grace did. Every seedling in the bed Grace tends produced 4 flowers this summer. A neighbour gave her another 15 flowers to go with them. The school sold each of Grace's flowers for 3 pounds at the fete, where the raffle had 250 tickets. Grace has been gardening at the school since she was a dozen years old. How many pounds did Grace's flowers raise?

A jam co-operative started the week with 16 boxes in its store. A member delivered 66 more boxes on Tuesday, and a second member brought 77 on Thursday. Every box in the store holds 9 jars. A cafe returned 70 unsold jars, which were stacked in with the rest. Each jar contains 8 spoonfuls of jam according to the label, and the co-operative's van can carry a dozen boxes at a time. The store itself measures 45 square metres. How many spoonfuls of jam are in the store?

A chocolate warehouse held 224 crates before the holiday rush and sent 135 of them out to shops. Every crate that stayed behind was split into 2 smaller boxes. A returning delivery added 64 more boxes of the same kind. Each box holds 8 packs, and every pack contains 6 bars. Each of those bars can be snapped into 4 squares. How many squares of chocolate does the warehouse hold?

Ravi counted 115 stamp sheets in his album and was given 7 more by his uncle. He then removed 16 sheets that were torn at the perforations. Every sheet he kept carries 4 stamps. His friend Tessa, whose collection is smaller than Ravi's, gave him 62 loose stamps from her own album. A dealer sold him another 71 loose stamps that afternoon. Ravi's catalogue prices everything in cents rather than dollars. How many stamps does Ravi have now?

A stadium kiosk took delivery of 221 trays of pies before the final. Each tray carried 5 boxes, and every box held 3 pies. Before kick-off the kiosk sold 412 pies to early arrivals. During the first half another 1735 pies went over the counter, and at half-time a further 529 were sold. The kiosk keeps a dozen staff on duty for a match like this, and the stadium itself holds 48000 spectators. How many pies are left in the kiosk?

Farid harvested 231 sacks of potatoes, and his cousin Amira, who farms a smaller field, added 71 sacks of her own to the pile. Every sack in the combined pile holds 8 kilograms. A late load added 15 kilograms of loose potatoes to the same pile. The market rejected 103 kilograms as too small and sent them elsewhere. A restaurant then returned 40 kilograms it could not use. How many kilograms of potatoes are in the pile now?

In the morning a print shop ran off 168 posters on each of its 6 machines. Before lunch a courier delivered 56 posters printed elsewhere, and they joined the same stack. During the afternoon 261 posters were pasted up around the town. In the evening a cancelled order sent 56 posters back to the stack. The shop's front window is 3 metres wide. How many posters are on the stack at the end of the day?

A label printer packed 45 crates, and each crate held 6 packets. A late order added 54 more packets of the same kind. Every packet contains 4 sheets, and each sheet is printed with 9 labels. The whole stock was divided equally between 4 branches, and the Riverside branch took one of those equal shares. The delivery van has covered 78000 kilometres, and the firm has been trading for a dozen years. How many labels went to the Riverside branch?

Yusuf counted 187 folding chairs in the hall store, rather more than his assistant Mrs. Adeyemi had counted the week before. A wedding party took 157 of them out to the marquee. The caretaker then returned 5 chairs that had not been needed. Every chair still in the store was hired out to a choir at 5 pounds each. Mending a broken table cost the hall 158 pounds, paid straight out of that hire money. Yusuf has looked after this hall for a dozen years. How many pounds were left from the hire money?
